reviews.comment: ENGL205. Great teacher and wants the best for her students. Willing to help and is very funny and easy to talk to. I recommend!
Dr. Owusu is amazing. She is very engaged with the material and works to push her students to the next level. She is also very funny and approachable. Take her if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Owusu is the best English instructor that I have ever had. She is a truly caring and funny person. She is often understanding and relatable in interaction and easily available outside of class. Her class was truly fun and informative as well as a healthy challenge of close reading and critical thinking. Take her class; you won't regret it!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are amazing and easy to follow, however, does heavily grade on discussion/participation. There are group projects and a lengthy final paper, but as long as you follow the rubric you'll be fine. She'll help in any way she can!

Dr. Owusu was a very nice woman, but she grades very hard. The class is reading heavy, and there are discussions every class about the assigned reading. She does not take attendance, but she expects you to be in class. Not a bad professor, but I did not get an A on any of the papers, and the average for the participation grade was an 85.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Owusu is a very kind women who has much insight on the curriculum. She challenges students thought processes and dives into insightful lectures each class. We had a couple of papers, none we very hard as she gives creative freedom in papers.

Professor Owusu is super knowledgeable on African American history and literature and provides a lot of different theories and approaches to the reading. She encourages critical thinking towards every text and always has engaging lectures and questions. Overall shes a super awesome professor who's always ready to work with students.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. She tackles not just African American literature, but the entire history surrounding these writings. She is supportive and attentive to your questions and when you talk to her about these issues, you never feel like you're walking on eggshells. She provides you with lengthy reading, but it is worth it for the discussions.
